we report the solution processing of a high dielectric constant material, zirconium dioxide, and the integration in a thin-film transistor with a high mobility and low subthreshold swing.
we report the first solution-processed high-k dielectric ZrO2 and demonstrate its integration in zinc tin oxide thin film transistors.

the integration of a solution-processed ZO2 dielectric into a thin-film transistor and the resulting performance.
the development of a low temperature, solution-based process for the deposition of high-k dielectric materials, such as ZrO2.
the integration of solution-processed high-k dielectrics and low temperature processing of thin-film transistors.
